reviews.summary: Binance removed QNT/USDC spot trading and QNT/USDC cross-margin support in September 2026. This does not delist QNT itself, but it is a current liquidity/access and venue-fragmentation risk during a momentum entry.
materialRisks: Binance ceased QNT/USDC spot trading on September 18, 2026, citing periodic pair-review criteria that can include liquidity and volume; QNT may remain available through other pairs. ([binance.com](https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/30b1347d97324180bb469c761e4eed5a?utm_source=openai))

Binance removed QNT/USDC from cross margin on September 11, 2026, including position closure/cancellation procedures. This reduces leverage-market access for that pair and can fragment liquidity. ([binance.com](https://www.binance.com/en/square/post/364835686055106?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: The affected actions concern the QNT/USDC pair, not a full QNT token delisting from Binance Spot. ([binance.com](https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/30b1347d97324180bb469c761e4eed5a?utm_source=openai))

Quant announced a Clearing House partnership on September 24, 2026; this is a major project announcement but not an adverse protocol/security event. ([quant.network](https://quant.network/press-releases/the-clearing-house-partners-with-quant-to-advance-the-on-chain-money-initiative/?utm_source=openai))
No directly corroborated fresh evidence was found of a QNT protocol exploit, critical outage, or scheduled token unlock in the reviewed results.
